title: eludite.commands.list input
description: The commands a person can run from the palette: every registered command with its title, its category (the title's part before `: `), its current shortcut in the active keymap and the arguments of the variant (View > Workspace is eludite.view.show with `{"id": "workspace"}`). `query` filters fuzzily on the title and category, best first; `features: true` adds the menu items (`kind: menu`, with their path) and the Options pages (`kind: options`).
